The upstream simulator path (sim) was not run: it needs ManiSkill, SAPIEN, Vulkan and the RoboCasa/RoboBenchMart assets plus generated scene data downloaded separately (README.md:15, README.md:45-55), and package code never imports the clone; fake.py is a small analytic stand-in. The driver's bridge does not read observation_space (the attribute belongs to ManiSkill's external BaseEnv), so cap.world.step.v1 keeps observation as an open object. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space and step (both come from the external ManiSkill BaseEnv that the clone does not contain), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the family-derived integer inputs and action values. Only cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
